2026-11-12: Maria Torres is good family friends with Jackie Diaz and her husband (per Colby).

2026-11-12: Villa 25 was built under a construction contract with Cary's construction company Comali VR S.A. de C.V. (signed 2021-07-21, USD 366,807.03 + USD 12,364.58 upgrades = USD 379,171.60). The company ran out of money at about 75% completion (Comali cost-to-finish sheet, Aug 2024), and the Philbricks finished the villa themselves. They paid Comali USD 362,490.90 (95.6%). The lot itself (USD 275,000, paid to Sueno) is separate and fully paid. Estimated amount Cary owes them: about USD 70k to 105k, best estimate about USD 78k. Basis: paid minus 75% of the contract price is about USD 75k to 78k. Comali's Aug 2024 cost to finish of MXN 1.68M (MXN 2.34M including MXN 659k of unpaid subcontractor debts), at about 19 MXN/USD, less the USD 16,680.70 unpaid contract balance, gives about USD 72k to 106k. The Philbricks' actual receipts are not on file. Colby intends to eventually offer them a Tres Aguas lot as compensation.
2026-11-12: Colby set USD ~106k as the compensation figure to offer (upper end, given how kind they have been to Cary).
